scripts.build: npm run build:icons && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-extension.mjs --alpha
scripts.build:store: npm run build:icons && tsc --noEmit && vite build && node scripts/build-extension.mjs
scripts.test:debug-chromium: cd tests/debug-chromium && python3 -m unittest test_contract test_rules
scripts.test:setup-headless-chromium: cd tests/setup-headless-chromium && PYTHONPATH=../debug-chromium python3 -m unittest test_headless
scripts.test:verify-chromium-performance: cd tests/verify-chromium-performance && PYTHONPATH=../debug-chromium python3 -m unittest test_measure test_worker_trace
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:discovery && npm test && npm run test:debug-chromium && npm run test:setup-headless-chromium && npm run test:verify-chromium-performance && npm run build:store && npm run test:e2e
scripts.check: npm run lint && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/check-ui-copy.mjs && node scripts/check-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-policy.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests scripts e2e .github *.json *.ts *.mjs *.html README.md public/manifest.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests scripts e2e .github *.json *.ts *.mjs *.html README.md public/manifest.json
